provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS original capability gap-closure master pump (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: 'unsafe-inline' next to a nonce is ignored by browsers, so the policy does not permit inline script and must not be reported (the rule used to fire on the keyword alone).

groundTruth.rationale: The script-src directive carries a nonce. CSP3 ignores 'unsafe-inline' when the same directive also carries a nonce or hash, so inline script is not permitted by this policy.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live page.
The nonce value here is a placeholder; the check never evaluates nonce quality.
